role: Exact complete second-public-law discriminator across all positive alternative first records, all pre-existing same-flux errors, and both fixed public actions
question: Does any positive alternative complete first record make the action-conditioned complete second public law distinguish one of the twelve candidate physical errors from the base on the same ideal orbit?

hypotheses.null: Each candidate and base share a complete second public law at every matched positive alternative first record under each fixed action.
hypotheses.witness: At least one candidate/action/first-record cell has positive exact total-variation distance from the matched base law; this is a restricted conditional-law witness, not a full-IID or logical-risk effect.

source_basis: R6AF remediated public binary charge interface and J6L/J6M paper-normalized periodic orbit
J8A all 52 exact first-record masses, including four zero-mass exclusions
J7Z all-plus complete-law result for 26 exact replay controls
J7X/J7Y/J7Z operator relation, conditional parity and Walsh methods
fork_classification: All three other base-positive first records and all twelve existing candidate errors are independent, reversible and in scope. Their complete second laws share expensive orbit moments, so run one signed-projector matrix rather than human-ranking or three independent repeats. First mass is the prerequisite already passed. A changed geometry or new error support requires a separately pinned state/cost and is not silently added.
frozen_model: Paper-normalized ideal periodic L=2 D4 orbit, 36 red physical-error edges, 24 full-binary public sites, thirteen private error supports from J8A and no new faults. First public flux/charge/vacuum is observed before action. The fixed relation-free public charge actions [0] and [1,30,32,34,35] apply after the first record, with action-conditioned second public flux/charge/vacuum. Error identity, orbital state and scoring remain private; no decoder observes them. No noisy repeated channel, new geometry, rate, policy or logical score is introduced.

matrix.design: Cross thirteen errors with four first public records and two actions: 104 total error/record/action cells. J8A fixes 48 positive error/record cells, giving 96 complete second laws; four zero-mass error/record cells are explicitly excluded under both actions. All-plus cases supply 26 exact J7Z replays. No candidate or action is chosen after seeing outcomes.
matrix.method: For each private error and action, compute first-projector orbit moments once, then reuse them with signed Walsh coefficients for every positive first record. Audit exact conditional one-site means on all 22 eligible second sites; retain deterministic zero/one charges, and identify every variable site. Fail closed if a marginal is neither deterministic nor fair or if more than five sites are variable. Compute every parity moment over those variable sites with anticommutation and exact stabilizer-relation shortcuts, then invert the complete Walsh transform to construct every nonzero full-binary public second record. The same public action is used for every private error and first record.
matrix.estimand: Exact total-variation distance between a candidate and base second-public law conditioned on the same positive complete first record and same fixed action. This is not mutual information under the full IID prior or unconditional logical loss.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact error/first-record/action cell on the selected ideal orbit; no Monte Carlo independent sampling unit or interval.
matrix.integrity: Pin inputs and runner before/after; verify J8A first masses, common full first/second flux, charge/vacuum exclusivity, first/second eligible operator commutation, all 22 conditional one-site means, nonnegative rational Walsh rows, unique public keys and normalization. All 26 all-plus laws must exactly replay J7Z; zero-first-mass cells must yield no conditional law.

acceptance: All 104 registered cells represented, exactly 96 positive complete-law cells and eight action cells excluded for zero first mass
Every eligible second charge accounted for, every positive exact law normalized, and all 26 all-plus complete laws replay J7Z
Report exact conditional-law equality or finite TV witnesses over every positive candidate/first-record/action cell, with zero-mass cells excluded rather than inferred
No full-IID information, unconditional logical-risk, noisy JIT, policy or threshold claim

outcomes.positive_witness: Report all exact finite conditional-law witnesses and preregister a separate restricted-support information calculation before any logical-risk or noisy-schedule claim.
outcomes.all_equal: The complete second law is identical on every positive cell in this thirteen-error/four-first-record/two-action ideal matrix; do not extend to full IID or other geometry.
outcomes.censored: On any pin, mass, flux, algebra, one-site, variable-site, Walsh, replay, term or CPU gate failure, release no complete-law comparison; preserve the failure and diagnose the earliest unsupported gate.

stop_rule: Stop after the fixed 104-cell matrix or sooner on a gate failure. No new error, first record, action, geometry, IID posterior, logical score, history, arm or bootstrap may be added adaptively.
